official_data_source.source_name: Lean 4 statistical and probabilistic identifiability proof corpus
official_data_source.source_authority: Lean project and Logion formal proof corpus steward

target_variable.name: stat_prob_formal_identifiability_heldout_sequents
target_variable.extraction_rule: Hold back expected_identifiability_verdict, countermodel_or_proof_ref, aggregate accept/reject counts by graph family until the formal proof route materializes from validation/heldout/grand_science/formal_mathematics/coverage_work_orders/planned_corpora/statistical_probabilistic_inference/OC133_STAT_PROB_IDENTIFIABILITY_FORMAL_INPUTS.json.
target_variable.target_statement: For held-out finite probability kernels, graphical/separation sequents, and intervention queries, prove whether the target query is identifiable from the declared observable distribution.

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Produce a Lean/finite proof or countermodel for each held-out identifiability sequent. A numeric posterior estimate, regression residual, simulation result, or empirical forecast is explicitly out of scope.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: classify every held-out query as identifiable using only unconditional independence and visible marginal signatures, without applying intervention/identifiability proof rules
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model_mismatch_count == 0, comparator_mismatch_count > 0, and non-identifiable controls are rejected

uncertainty_requirement.rule: No empirical uncertainty interval is applicable; proof checker verdicts are exact.

residual_requirement.formula: sum(1 if preregistered_formal_verdict != executed_formal_verdict else 0) over locked formal rows
residual_requirement.definition: 0/1 mismatch between the preregistered formal derivation verdict and the executed proof or countermodel verdict; aggregate count and exact zero required for accepted formal support.
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: model_mismatch_count == 0, comparator_mismatch_count > 0, and non-identifiable controls are rejected

negative_control_requirement.rule: formal replay emits REJECT/countermodel and the comparator's identifiable verdict fails
negative_control_requirement.description: A held-out latent-confounding or label-swap construction known only through the locked target corpus must be rejected as non-identifiable.

falsifier_requirement.trigger: empirical numeric prediction, simulation fit, or posterior calibration is used as proof of identifiability; withheld verdicts, aggregate accept/reject counts, or countermodel refs leak before proof materialization; fewer than 20 formal-equivalent held-out sequents replay; the independence-only comparator ties or beats the formal derivation; any proof/countermodel ref is missing, unhashable, or not reproducible
trigger_predicates: empirical numeric prediction, simulation fit, or posterior calibration is used as proof of identifiability
withheld verdicts, aggregate accept/reject counts, or countermodel refs leak before proof materialization
fewer than 20 formal-equivalent held-out sequents replay
the independence-only comparator ties or beats the formal derivation
any proof/countermodel ref is missing, unhashable, or not reproducible

current_evidence.reason: Deterministic formal-route identifiability inputs, executed proof corpus, withheld aggregate lock, and scorer are materialized and replay cleanly. Coverage remains open pending formal coverage-scope review.

source_proof_corpus.scope_boundary: This lane is about machine-checkable identifiability and probabilistic inference theorems. It must not treat empirical fit, calibration, simulation accuracy, or numeric prediction as coverage evidence.
